# SC-07: An order from an unknown customer makes no invoice

## Steps
1. Send the test purchase order from a customer that is not in QuickBooks Online.
2. Check the exceptions list and the sandbox's invoices.

## Expected result
No invoice is made and the order is on the exceptions list (1 case).

## Data (by pointer only)
Source: a purchase order made for the test; records: the one test order; count: 1; fields: customer.
